question: How has registered marriage at the same age changed?
marks_and_channels: Rectangles; x Census year; y age group; sequential colour share_pct
why_this_idiom: Compare the age pattern across Census years.
annotation_task: Annotate the strongest supported same-age change.
interaction: Year and age highlight; exact-value tooltip

question: How do never-married age profiles differ for women and men?
marks_and_channels: Mirrored bars; y age; x share_pct; colour sex
why_this_idiom: Compare age profiles on a common percentage scale.
annotation_task: Highlight an age group with a meaningful difference.

question: How do partnership arrangements vary by age?
filter_and_scope: People; one selected year; three exclusive statuses
marks_and_channels: Rectangles; column width age-group total; segment height status share
why_this_idiom: Show the joint age and partnership distribution.
annotation_task: Explain that area represents people, not probability.

question: How has the age pattern of childbirth shifted?
marks_and_channels: Offset filled curves; x age; height births_per_1000_women
why_this_idiom: Compare the location and shape of fertility profiles.
annotation_task: Annotate peak age-band shifts supported by the rates.
interaction: Highlight a year; exact rate tooltip

question: Are successive completed cohorts having fewer children?
marks_and_channels: Line; x mother birth cohort; y completed_children_per_woman
why_this_idiom: Distinguish completed family size from annual fertility.
annotation_task: Explain why younger cohorts are absent.

question: How has the age of parents at birth changed?
marks_and_channels: Lines; x registration year; y age; colour parent
why_this_idiom: Compare long-term movement in parental ages.
annotation_task: Label medians as all births, not first births.

question: How do family size and parent arrangement fit together?
filter_and_scope: One selected year; three parent arrangements; 1,2,3,4+ children
marks_and_channels: Ribbons; width families_count; nodes arrangement and child count
why_this_idiom: Show actual joint counts at one Census snapshot.
annotation_task: Flows do not mean families changed arrangement.

question: How has the mix of family types changed?
filter_and_scope: All six family types; selected year
why_this_idiom: Show the family population and its structure.
annotation_task: Call out change and continuity across 2011-2021.

question: Are young adults staying with parents longer?
marks_and_channels: Points and lines; x year; y living_with_parents_pct
why_this_idiom: Compare successive cohorts at the same age.
annotation_task: Use published change and significance notes.

question: Where did fertility rates change most?
why_this_idiom: Show the spatial pattern of change.
annotation_task: Explain three-year averages and start/end periods.

question: Where do births and changes in parent age intersect?
rubric_role: Map 2; do not rely on advanced count
marks_and_channels: Symbols at representative points; area births; colour age change
why_this_idiom: Combine the scale of births with change in parental age.
annotation_task: Distinguish symbol area from radius and colour.

question: How does the pattern look when regions represent people?
marks_and_channels: Resized regions; area population; colour fertility change
why_this_idiom: Reveal whether large land areas dominate the conventional map.
interaction: Region labels and tooltip; tutor classification check
